description: A candle-making company can move their inventory of candles using freight and air. Freight can transport 5 tons per trip while using air can transport 3 tons per trip. Since freight take longer, the cost for each freight trip is $300 while the cost over air for each trip is $550. The company needs to transport at least 200 tons of candles and they have a budget of $20000. Additionally, due to some urgent orders, at least 30% of tons of candles must be transported through air. There must also be at least 5 trips through freight. How many of trip by each should be scheduled to minimize the total number of trips?

FreightCapacityPerTrip.definition: Amount of tons freight can transport per trip

AirCapacityPerTrip.definition: Amount of tons air can transport per trip

FreightCostPerTrip.definition: Cost per freight trip in dollars

AirCostPerTrip.definition: Cost per air trip in dollars

MinimumAirProportion.definition: Minimum proportion of tons to transport via air

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of freight and air trips required to transport the candles"

constraints.description: Total tons transported by freight and air must be at least the minimum required: 5 * FreightTrips + 3 * AirTrips >= 200
Total transportation cost must not exceed the budget: 300 * FreightTrips + 550 * AirTrips <= 20000
At least 30% of the total tons transported must be transported by air: 7 * AirTrips >= 5 * FreightTrips
The number of freight trips must be at least 5: FreightTrips >= 5
The number of air trips must be non-negative: AirTrips >= 0
The number of freight and air trips must be integers

FreightTrips.definition: Number of trips made using freight transportation

AirTrips.definition: Number of trips made using air transportation
